name: decider-31b-fp8
readout: next-token logits of the option letters at the answer position, one forward pass, nothing generated

limits.truncation: head/tail of the state when over the limit; never refused

calibration_fit.on: own generated decision items only (no JevBench item in any fitting set): raw (T=1) outputs from this exact serving path (vLLM 0.31.0, FP8, H100 80GB) on results/dev/*.jsonl = dev_cal_clean (649) + two frozen-hard holdouts (170 + 210); per type, a difficulty-matched subsample (n = 920) whose accuracy matches the target: choice 0.878 from deck-31B's published sealed-half choice CC 83.9 (same frozen recipe); noul 0.925 = this system's accuracy on the 74 public noul items (0.946) minus the board's ~2-point public-sealed gap (the official noul CC is depressed by abstentions and not usable as a target); score temperature fixed at 1 (its competence uses the expected level)
calibration_fit.objective: per type: chance-corrected competence + the JevBench calibration term
calibration_fit.public_check_not_fitted_on: 231 public items through the official CLI on the H100 (FP8): 213/231 correct, 0 failures

quantization: fp8 (vLLM on-the-fly quantisation of the pinned bf16 checkpoint; the measured and calibrated configuration)
